values.name: Negate
values.value: Negate the value. Applies to Integer, Long Integers, Big Integer and Boolean types.

values.name: Decrement
values.value: Subtract the Adjustment Parameter to the value. Applies to Integer, Long Integers, Big Integer, Interval, Date Time, and Date Time Extended. The default is parameter is 1 for numeric types, 1 second for Date Time, and 1 microsecond for Date Time Extended.
